column5: At that time, in a certain village. Retired hero Theoman

column4: \t\t引退した勇者テオマンが幸せに過ごしていたが
column5: was spending his days happily, but... Monsters attacked,

column4: \t\t魔物に攻め込まれ恋人も殺されてしまう
column5: and his lover was killed. He returned to being a hero

column4: \t\t聖女セラクロラスの力を借りて勇者に復帰
column5: with the help of the saintess Serachrolas' power. He

column4: \t\t今度は非情に徹した勇者になると誓う
column5: swore to become a hero who is utterly ruthless this time.
